text:
Anya: FYI CI is red on sampleapp regen after I switched the onboard pipeline to use Azure managed identity creds. Typegen diffs showing auth types changing shape :facepalm:
Liam: ugh, can you paste the regen diff?
Anya: small snippet from the failing job: ```diff
- export type Auth = { token?: string }
+ export type Auth = { credential?: unknown }
```
Anya: the codegen emitted `credential?: unknown` instead of `token?: string` which breaks SDK parity tests and semver checks on publish.
Devon: did the OpenAPI spec change? or runtime typegen mapping?
Anya: spec didn't change AFAIK. I think our azure-auth transform in typegen is picking up `x-auth-type: azure` and mapping to `credential` instead of `token`.
Liam: @Devon think this could be a recent helper we landed that normalizes `x-` fields? I remember a PR that tried to make provider-agnostic auth shapes.
Devon: yes 1752943002 - I added a normalizer. It tries to unify `auth.token` -> `credential` when provider != "redwood". Might be too aggressive.
Samir: CI bot shows the failing checks: 
CI Bot: build/sampleapp-typegen-regendiff — FAILED
CI Bot: check/regendiff-semver-guard — FAILED (breaking types)
Marie: quick mitigation: revert the normalizer or gate it behind a flag and run regen again. We can't ship a breaking type change without bumping semver/changelog.
Liam: agree. Can we patch the normalizer to preserve `token` when the operation has `x-legacy-auth: true`? Some of our sampleapps rely on that marker.
Devon: hmm there's no `x-legacy-auth` in the spec. But we could detect if the original vendor extension was `x-auth-token` vs `x-managed-cred` and only rename for the latter.
Anya: for the short-term I'll revert the normalizer on the typegen branch and run `./scripts/regenerate-sdks.sh sampleapp`.
Anya: output after revert: ```diff
- export type Auth = { credential?: unknown }
+ export type Auth = { token?: string }
```
Anya: regen job passed locally. Pushing fix now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482
Liam: nice. can we add an automated unit test for provider-agnostic renames so this doesn't bit us again?
Devon: yes will add a commit to typegen tests that asserts mapping rules for azure/google/aws and ensures legacy token names preserved.
Samir: also patch the semver guard to surface helpful hints in the CI log (e.g., "type X changed: consider semver major or update changelog") — current failure just says "breaking change".
Marie: created a ticket for CI UX improvements: #DEVEX-1024.
CI Bot: build/sampleapp-typegen-regendiff — SUCCESS (after branch revert)
Anya: thanks everyone. I'll merge the hotfix and follow up with tests + CI UX improvements. :thumbsup:
